s: Established in April 2001 by the Class of Science '89 and awarded on the basis of financial need to an upper-year student in Smith Engineering. Application should be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid and Awards by October 31.

f: Queen's University
s: Established under the ThankQ program by the Class of Science '95 upon their graduation and awarded on the basis of financial need to two students in their second, third or fourth year in Smith Engineering who have been involved in some form of extra-curricular activity (i.e. athletics, part-time employment, school council, etc.).

f: Queen's University
s: Established by the Class of Science 1999, with donations to the ThankQ '99 Class Gift Campaign. Awarded to a full-time second, third or fourth year student in Smith Engineering on the basis of financial need and involvement in extracurricular activities that could include employment with a Queen's organization.

f: Queen's University
s: Awarded to an undergraduate student in second or third year in either Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, on the basis of satisfactory academic performance, financial need and participation in a wide range of student activities.
